head: 8ac9b21740076af5991a40f3fdcfb46d5b7ee405
summary: Cold/paired review approved current Phase 1-5 vertical slices after fixes. Path and symlink reads are confined, workers are capped, context token budgets are hard, session registries are root-scoped and capped, typed graph BUILD files are complete, and sessionlog/workflow/adapters are bounded and content-safe. HTTP timeout cancellation remains a low-medium follow-up because legacy codecrawl methods lack context plumbing, not a release blocker for loopback local-first use.
